1º de Primaria · Inglés

Animals

Ficha para imprimir
123456
1

Pregunta de arranquePiensa 30 segundos antes de seguir

Have you got a pet? What animal is it? Can you say it in English?

Escribe o di en voz alta tu respuesta. Después .

Maybe a cat, a dog or a fish. In this unit you will meet many animals: pets, farm animals and wild animals.

2

Aprende12 apartados

Para empezar: A day at the farm

Today Hugo's class visits a farm. The farmer's name is Kate.

«Look! This is a cow», says Kate. The cow says «Moo!».

Then they see a pig in the mud. «Oink, oink!» Hugo laughs.

Next to the pond there are ducks. «Quack, quack!» A little duck swims to Hugo.

«What's your favourite animal?» asks Kate. «The horse!» says Hugo. «It can run very fast.»

On the bus, the children sing an animal song all the way home.

1. Pets

A pet is an animal that lives with us at home.

Popular pets are a cat, a dog and a fish.

We feed our pets and play with them. Have you got a pet? I've got a dog.

2. More pets

Some children have a bird, a rabbit or a mouse.

A bird sings. A rabbit has long ears. A mouse is very small.

Pets need water, food and love. Look after your pet every day!

3. Farm animals

On a farm there are many animals.

There is a cow, a pig, a duck and a hen.

The cow gives us milk. The hen gives us eggs. Have you ever visited a farm?

Vídeo: The Animals On The Farm · Super Simple Songs (YouTube) · 513,2 millones de visualizaciones

4. Animal sounds

Animals make sounds. In English they sound a little different!

A dog says Woof! A cat says Meow! A cow says Moo!

A pig says Oink! A duck says Quack! Can you make the sounds?

Vídeo: The Animal Sounds Song · Natural English (YouTube) · 368,4 millones de visualizaciones

5. Wild animals

Wild animals live in the jungle, the savannah or the forest.

The lion is strong. The elephant is very big. The monkey is funny.

We can see some wild animals at the zoo.

6. Small animals

Some animals are very small.

A butterfly has beautiful wings. An ant is tiny. A frog is green and jumps.

A snail is very slow. Look for small animals in the park!

7. Big and small

We can describe animals: big or small.

The elephant is big. The mouse is small.

We can add colours too: a big grey elephant, a small brown mouse.

8. It can swim!

Animals can do many things. We say It can…

A fish can swim. A bird can fly. A frog can jump. A horse can run.

And you? I can jump! I can swim!

Vídeo: Yes, I Can! Animal Song For Children · Super Simple Songs (YouTube) · 308,4 millones de visualizaciones

9. What's this animal?

Play a guessing game. Ask: What's this animal?

Give clues: It's big. It's grey. It's got a long nose.

Your friend answers: It's an elephant! Now it's your turn.

10. Animals' homes

Animals live in different places.

A fish lives in the sea or a fish tank. A bird lives in a tree.

A cow lives on a farm. A lion lives in the savannah. Where do you live?

11. Game: animal charades

Play animal charades!

Move like an animal. Don't speak! You can make the sound.

Your friends guess: Are you a monkey? Yes, I am! or No, I'm not! Then it's another child's turn.

12. Review: I love animals

Now you know many animals: pets, farm animals, wild animals and small animals.

You know their sounds and what they can do.

Say your favourite: My favourite animal is the lion! Well done!

Lo hacemos juntos · Let's do it together

What animal says «Moo»?

  1. Think of the farm.
  2. It gives us milk.

Resultado: A cow.

Can a fish fly?

  1. A fish lives in the water.
  2. It can swim, not fly.

Resultado: No, it can't. It can swim.

Describe an elephant with two words.

  1. Think of its size: big.
  2. Think of its colour: grey.

Resultado: It's big and grey.

What's your favourite animal?

  1. Choose an animal you like.
  2. Start with: My favourite animal is…

Resultado: My favourite animal is the dog.

Errores típicos

  • Saying «a elephant»: before a vowel sound we say «an elephant».
  • Saying «two mouse»: the plural of mouse is mice.
  • Putting the colour after the animal: «a grey elephant», not «an elephant grey».
  • Saying «It can to swim»: we say «It can swim».

Ejercicios (22)

Hazlos en tu cuaderno y después abre la solución.

Nivel básico

  1. Say three pets in English.

    Ver solución
    Cat, dog, fish (or bird, rabbit).

  2. Make the sound of a dog.

    Ver solución
    Woof! Woof!

  3. Draw a fish and colour it.

    Ver solución
    A fish in any colour.

  4. Point to the cow in the picture.

    Ver solución
    The cow.

  5. Match: gato – cat, perro – dog.

    Ver solución
    Cat = gato; dog = perro.

  6. Is an elephant big or small?

    Ver solución
    Big.

  7. Move like a frog: jump!

    Ver solución
    The child jumps.

  8. What animal says «Quack»?

    Ver solución
    A duck.

Nivel medio

  1. Complete: A bird can ____.

    Ver solución
    fly.

  2. Complete: A fish can ____.

    Ver solución
    swim.

  3. Write two farm animals.

    Ver solución
    For example, cow and pig.

  4. Write two wild animals.

    Ver solución
    For example, lion and elephant.

  5. Answer: What's your favourite animal?

    Ver solución
    My favourite animal is… (free answer).

  6. Describe a mouse: It's ____ and ____.

    Ver solución
    small and grey (or brown).

  7. Where does a fish live?

    Ver solución
    In the sea / in a fish tank.

  8. Play animal charades with a friend.

    Ver solución
    Free answer.

  9. Count the animals on the farm picture and say: There are…

    Ver solución
    Free answer, for example: five animals.

Nivel avanzado

  1. Give three clues about an animal. Your friend guesses.

    Ver solución
    For example: It's big. It's grey. It's got a long nose. It's an elephant!

  2. Write what you can do: I can… (three things).

    Ver solución
    For example: I can run, I can jump, I can swim.

  3. Draw your dream pet and describe it.

    Ver solución
    Free answer, for example: It's a small blue cat. It can fly!

  4. Sort the animals: pets / farm / wild: lion, cat, cow, dog, elephant, pig.

    Ver solución
    Pets: cat, dog. Farm: cow, pig. Wild: lion, elephant.

  5. Sing the animal sounds song and teach it to your family.

    Ver solución
    Free answer.

Explícalo con tus palabrasComo si se lo contaras a alguien de un curso menor

¿Has nombrado estas ideas?
★

Situación de aprendizajeOur class zoo

We make a zoo in our classroom with animal drawings and we guide visitors in English.

Pasos

  1. Each child chooses an animal and draws it on a card.
  2. We write: This is a… It's big / small. It can…
  3. We group the animals: pets, farm animals and wild animals.
  4. We guide another class: «Welcome to our zoo! This is a lion. It can run».

Producto final: A classroom zoo with animal cards and a guided tour in English.

Cómo se valora

  • Names animals in English.
  • Uses big / small and It can…
  • Sorts animals into pets, farm and wild.

Resumen visualTodo el tema en una pantalla

Glosario

Animal
A living thing that moves and eats, like a cat (animal).
Pet
An animal that lives with you at home (mascota).
Farm
A place with cows, pigs and hens (granja).
Wild
Living free in nature, not at home (salvaje).
Cat
A small pet that says meow (gato).
Dog
A pet that says woof (perro).
Cow
A farm animal that gives milk (vaca).
Lion
A big, strong wild cat (león).
Swim
Move in the water (nadar).
Fly
Move in the air (volar).
6

Tarjetas de repasoToca la tarjeta para darle la vuelta

Según cómo respondas, la tarjeta vuelve mañana, en 3, en 7 o en 21 días.

Para familias

  • Imitad sonidos de animales en inglés: woof, meow, moo, oink, quack.
  • Jugad a adivinar animales con pistas: «It's big. It's grey».
  • Si tenéis mascota, habladle en inglés un ratito al día.
  • Mirad juntos un documental corto de animales y nombrad los que conozcáis.

Para profesores

Saberes: Lengua extranjera (Inglés): léxico de animales (mascotas, granja y salvajes); onomatopeyas en inglés; estructura It can…; adjetivos big / small y colores; preguntas sobre preferencias (RD 157/2022, primer ciclo de Educación Primaria).

  • Mímica de animales (charades) con preguntas Are you a…?
  • Canciones de animales con movimiento.
  • Clasificación de tarjetas de animales en tres grupos.
  • Zoo de clase con visitas guiadas en inglés.

Fuentes y revisión

  • Real Decreto 157/2022, enseñanzas mínimas de la Educación Primaria (BOE)

Revisado el 14 de noviembre de 2026.

Qué vas a aprender

  • Name pets: cat, dog, fish, bird, rabbit
  • Name farm animals: cow, pig, duck, hen, horse
  • Name wild animals: lion, elephant, monkey, frog
  • Say what animals can do: It can swim / jump / fly
  • Ask and answer What's your favourite animal?

Palabras clave

animal · cat · dog · fish · bird · cow · pig · lion · elephant · It can… · big · small

Tiempo

50 minutos hoy + 2 minutos en cada repaso
